title: State funding for K-12, billions of dollars, not adjusted for inflation: 2025-27 adopted and 2027-29 estimates
description: Bar chart: the 2025-27 State School Fund, its 2027-29 current service level, and the Quality Education Commission's two 2027-29 estimates.

bars.label: Keep 2025-27 service levels
bars.group: Commission estimate, all core state funding

bars.label: Meet the state's goals
bars.group: Commission estimate, all core state funding

notes: The current service level is the cost of continuing existing programs [SRC:gov/press/2024_ssf-csl-proposal.html], updating the last budget for pay, benefits, pension rates, inflation and enrollment [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.111] [SRC:legislature/olis/2025R1/307212_sb5516-ssf-work-session.pdf p.2]. The figure shown is the Department of Administrative Services' estimate in the Quality Education Commission's 2026 Quality Education Model report, released August 2026 [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.1] [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.13] [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.103].

The commission's two estimates are core K-12 state funding, the State School Fund and other state money; its estimate for keeping 2025-27 service levels is the State School Fund's current service level plus other state money [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.103] [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.117]. The commission leaves what counts as adequate to the Legislature [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.117].
